Req Name: Vibrational Durability and Functional Integrity Compliance
Details: Lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal use, despite the vibrations to which they may then be subjected, they continue to function satisfactorily and retain the characteristics prescribed by this Rule.
Minimum: 0.3 cd within the angles of light distribution of clause 6.1.3.
Vertical: from 5° above to 15° below the horizontal.
Horizontal: forward from 45° to the left to 45° to the right.
